image_description: A high-angle view of a steep, stratified rock cliff face dropping into dark ocean water. The cliff shows distinct horizontal geological layers and rough texture with patches of green vegetation on the left edge. White foamy waves crash against the base of the cliff and swirl in the water below.

The very top edge of the cliff blends slightly softly into the background/haze, lacking the crisp geometric definition expected of a sharp rock edge, though this could be atmospheric.
